settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Name
settings.assistantsDescription: Connect Claude or ChatGPT to add expenses and ask for summaries from your phone.
settings.claudeSteps: In Claude, open Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector, paste the URL, and sign in with your email when asked.
settings.chatgptSteps: In ChatGPT, enable developer mode under Settings → Apps & Connectors → Advanced, create a connector with the URL, and sign in with your email.
settings.assistantsHint: Once connected on the web, the connector is also available in the mobile apps.
settings.appearanceDescription: Choose how Finance Wingman looks on this device.

subscriptions.empty: No subscriptions yet. Add the recurring bills and income you want to keep track of.
subscriptions.name: Name
subscriptions.lockedHint: The type and account cannot be changed after creation.

workspaces.leaveDescription: You will lose access to its accounts and transactions until someone invites you again.
workspaces.lastOwner: A workspace needs at least one owner. Make another member an owner first.
workspaces.inviteDescription: We'll email them a link to join. It expires in 7 days.
workspaces.inviteConflict: That person is already a member, or too many invitations were sent recently.
workspaces.revokeDescription: The link in their email will stop working.
